name: Mix1-1A
summary: One-input chain mixer, as the G2's (its Lin/dB/Exp curves still missing).
author: Animatek
about: One mixer channel with a level, an On button and a chain input. The output is the chain plus the input times the level, so you can string several together to make a bigger mixer.
Based on the G2's Mixer 1-1 A.
usage: Plug a source into In and set Level.
Plug the Out of another Mix1-1A into Chain to add its signal: each module is one channel of the mixer.
Switch On off to mute the channel without unplugging it. The chain still passes through.
notes: Missing: the Lin / dB / Exp level curves of the G2's mixers. The level follows the G1 Mixer's own curve for now.

patch_notes.mix1-1a-chain.pch: OscA through two chained Mix1-1A channels: each is one mixer channel, and B adds A's output.
